description: This file contains implementation of a fake proof source class used for testing in the QUIC protocol, including methods for handling proof and signature requests, managing pending operations, and interacting with delegate proof sources.

classes.name: FakeProofSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of a proof source used for testing QUIC protocol features, capable of handling proof and signature requests, managing pending operations, and delegating to real proof sources.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::GetProofOp
classes.description: Represents a proof request operation within FakeProofSource, encapsulating the parameters and callback for getting proof.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::ComputeSignatureOp
classes.description: Represents a signature computation operation within FakeProofSource, encapsulating parameters and callback for computing TLS signatures.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::PendingOp
classes.description: Base class for pending operations in FakeProofSource.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::FakeProofSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fake proof source with a test proof source delegate.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::GetProof
methods.description: Handles proof requests, either directly delegating or queuing as a pending operation.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Handles TLS signature requests, either directly or as a pending operation.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::Activate
methods.description: Activates the fake proof source to start queuing operations.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain from the delegate.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::SupportedTlsSignatureAlgorithms
methods.description: Returns supported TLS signature algorithms from the delegate.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the ticket crypter if set, otherwise delegates.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::NumPendingCallbacks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending callback operations.

methods.name: FakeProofSource::InvokePendingCallback
methods.description: Invokes and removes a pending callback operation by index.
